name: FRED
label: FRED
description: FRED official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: series_search, series_get, series_observations, category_get, release_get. Docs: https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/fred/. St. Louis Fed FRED API. Free key. Attribution to FRED / source agency. file_type=json baked into paths. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One FRED request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"series_search"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: series_search | series_get | series_observations | category_get | release_get. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'series_search'.

schema.label: category_id
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `category_id` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: frequency
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `frequency` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: series_search page size (FRED max 1000). Official limit.

schema.label: observation_end
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `observation_end` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: observation_start
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `observation_start` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: release_id
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `release_id` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: search_text
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `search_text` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: series_id
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `series_id` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: units
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `units` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: series_search, series_get, series_observations, category_get, release_get.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: FRED API key: exactly 32 lowercase letters and digits (register at fred.stlouisfed.org). Query auth only; bind a secret here, never on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 25. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
